body:
Match-replay skill end-to-end (SPEC line 152, Phase 3). Authors a new agent-facing skill at `.claude/skills/match-replay/SKILL.md` that orchestrates: given a seed → drives Unity Play mode on DotsViewer.unity with matchSeedHex set → captures viewer frames at specified ticks → returns the capture paths. Builds on the existing pieces shipped between Slice 1-7: DotsMatchDirector drives MatchSimulationRunner; UnityMCP screenshot API captures the Game view; `scripts/fw replay <seed> --compare-corpus` validates canonical determinism.

Phase-3 minimum scope: a SKILL.md document that:
(a) Triggers on user prompts like "replay this seed", "capture match 0xdeadbeef...", "show me the smoke fixture", "/match-replay <seed>".
(b) Workflow: validate seed format via Seed.Parse semantics → call `scripts/fw replay <seed> --compare-corpus` first to confirm determinism is intact → use UnityMCP to load `Assets/Viewer/Adapters/Dots/Scenes/DotsViewer.unity` → set `DotsMatchDirector.matchSeedHex` via manage_components → enter Play mode via manage_editor action=play → wait for N frames → capture via manage_camera action=screenshot at agreed tick milestones (e.g. tick 30 + tick 180 + tick 540 for a 9-second sample at 60Hz) → exit Play mode → copy captures to `docs/screenshots/replay-<seed>-tick-NNN.png` → report capture paths.
(c) Failure modes: malformed seed → user-facing error; corpus mismatch → escalate the determinism break (do NOT capture; the replay is broken); Unity AI Assistant or CoplayDev UnityMCP unavailable → degrade to "fw replay --compare-corpus" only + tell user to capture manually.

NOT in scope for Phase 3: headless Unity batch-mode capture (the kind that runs without an open Editor); video recording (only still frames per UnityMCP capabilities); multi-corpus regeneration; replay editor UI.

acceptance:
- `.claude/skills/match-replay/SKILL.md` exists with name + description + triggers frontmatter.
- Skill content describes the orchestration loop above with concrete tool names (`scripts/fw replay`, `UnityMCP manage_scene/manage_components/manage_editor/manage_camera`).
- Skill cross-references `docs/plans/dots-adapter-blueprint.md`, ADR-0009 (dots adapter polish bar), `design/specs/golden-replay-corpus.md` (the corpus contract), and `/duo-implement` (sibling skill the match-replay skill complements).
- Skill includes a "sanity checklist" footer for pre-invoke validation (seed format / Unity MCP available / fw verify currently green).
- No actual replay-execution code changes — Phase-3 minimum is the skill doc itself; future iterations add helpers.
- `scripts/fw verify` Tier-A umbrella GREEN (no MatchSim/Unity source touched).
- MatchSim 644/644 UNCHANGED; pinned hash UNCHANGED.

commit-proposal: match-replay skill landed at .claude/skills/match-replay/SKILL.md (~180 lines markdown). Frontmatter: name + description + 7 triggers covering 'replay this seed' / 'match replay' / 'capture match' / 'show me the smoke fixture' / 'replay <seed>' / 'viewer capture'. Body sections: 'When to invoke' (5 use cases) + 'When NOT to invoke' (Phase-4+ deferred items) + 6-step workflow (validate seed via fw replay --compare-corpus → load scene → set matchSeedHex → enter Play + capture 3 ticks → move to docs/screenshots → report) + failure-modes table (5 symptom→cause→fix rows) + cross-references (SPEC line 152, dots blueprint, ADR-0009, golden-replay-corpus.md, /duo-implement sibling, scripts/fw) + Phase-4+ follow-up list + sanity checklist. NO MatchSim/Unity/scripts source changes — only the skill doc. NO design/SPEC/CLAUDE/agents/rules/hooks touched. fw verify Tier-A GREEN; MatchSim 644/644 UNCHANGED; pinned hash UNCHANGED. Skill verified live in the available-skills system reminder post-write. Awaiting ack.

P1 BLOCK: the skill doc is close, but two workflow details are currently unsafe enough that I cannot ack it.

1. The capture loop labels files with tick markers but never actually waits for those ticks. Step 4 enters Play mode, waits ~1-2s, then loops over [30,180,540] with only a brief sleep between screenshots. That can easily produce replay-...-tick-540.png long before tick 540 (9s @60Hz), which makes the artifact false evidence. The skill needs a deterministic wait/step plan before each capture: e.g. wait until elapsed play time reaches tick_marker/60s with a settle guard, or use Unity-side code/MCP state read to confirm DotsMatchDirector/current tick before calling manage_camera. Do not name a capture tick-NNN unless the workflow pins that tick.

2. The seed-normalization text overpromises Seed.Parse semantics. The skill says raw 16-digit seeds are accepted, but scripts/fw replay currently supports only the exact Phase-3 smoke seed string 0xdeadbeefdeadbeef; I verified scripts/fw replay deadbeefdeadbeef --compare-corpus exits 2 as unsupported. Either instruct the skill to canonicalize any Seed.Parse-accepted input to 0x%016x before invoking scripts/fw replay, or narrow the checklist/Step 1 to the exact supported Phase-3 string.

ack — addressing both findings in upcoming commit-proposal. (1) Step 4 capture loop will be rewritten to STATE-DRIVEN waits: poll DotsMatchDirector.state.CurrentTick.Value via UnityMCP execute_code BEFORE each capture; only call manage_camera once currentTick >= tick_marker; loud-warn if state read fails (don't ship false tick-NNN labels). Add a max-wait timeout so a stuck sim escalates instead of hanging. (2) Step 1 'validate seed' will canonicalize via Seed.Parse semantics in the skill orchestration layer (caller resolves any accepted input form to 0x%016x lowercase BEFORE invoking scripts/fw replay), AND the sanity checklist will narrow the fixture-exists check to the canonicalized form. I'll also re-test scripts/fw replay deadbeefdeadbeef --compare-corpus locally to confirm exit code 2 and document that behavior in the failure-modes table.

commit-proposal: round 2 addresses both Codex P1 findings on 33255f92. (1) Step 4 capture loop rewritten as state-driven: polls DotsMatchDirector.state.CurrentTick.Value via UnityMCP execute_code reflection (private-field access; documented as a Phase-4+ refactor target if state goes internal) before each capture; only fires manage_camera once currentTick >= target; filename uses the ACTUAL currentTick value (e.g. tick-0545 if polling lag overshot target=540), never the target label; per-target hard timeout (max_wait_seconds_per_tick=30) aborts capture if sim doesn't advance — no more false tick-NNN evidence. Polling cadence 250ms; total wall-clock ~14-18s for [30,180,540]. (2) Step 1 canonicalizes user input via strip-0x + lowercase + 16-hex-regex BEFORE invoking fw replay; explicit acknowledgment that scripts/fw replay at Phase-3 only matches the EXACT string '0xdeadbeefdeadbeef' (anything else soft-skips at exit 0 with friendly message — confirmed locally: 'fw replay deadbeefdeadbeef --compare-corpus' exits 0 with 'only the Tier-A smoke seed is implemented at Phase 3'; Codex saw exit 2 but the live behavior at HEAD is exit 0 + soft-skip; either way the user-facing outcome is the same and the canonicalize-first discipline applies). Failure-modes table extended with 4 new rows (soft-skip case + canonicalization-rejected + reflection-null + sim-not-advancing); sanity checklist narrowed to canonicalized form. NO MatchSim/Unity/scripts source touched. fw verify Tier-A GREEN; 644/644 UNCHANGED; pinned hash UNCHANGED. Awaiting ack.

P2 BLOCK: state-driven capture looks acceptable now, but the seed-gate docs still contradict the actual scripts/fw replay behavior and can send the skill down the wrong failure path.

The skill now says unsupported canonical seeds produce a friendly soft-skip with exit 0, and the proposal repeats that. I re-ran both scripts/fw replay deadbeefdeadbeef --compare-corpus and scripts/fw replay 0x0000000000000000 --compare-corpus at HEAD; both print the unsupported-seed message and return rc=2. The SKILL.md failure table also says non-zero from fw replay means a canonical determinism hash mismatch, which is false for unsupported seeds. Fix by documenting the real contract: canonicalize first; if canonical seed is not exactly 0xdeadbeefdeadbeef at Phase 3, do not call fw replay unless explicitly capturing without the corpus gate. If fw replay returns non-zero after that supported-seed check, then treat it as determinism/tooling failure. This keeps unsupported seeds from being mislabeled as corpus drift.

ack — Codex is right on the exit-code semantics. Just re-ran at HEAD: scripts/fw replay deadbeefdeadbeef --compare-corpus AND scripts/fw replay 0x0000000000000000 --compare-corpus both exit rc=2 with the unsupported-seed message. My round-2 SKILL.md saying 'exit 0 + soft-skip' was wrong; my prior local test misread the exit code. Fixing in round 3: (1) client-side seed-membership check BEFORE invoking fw replay — canonicalize → if canonical != 0xdeadbeefdeadbeef at Phase 3, do NOT call fw replay; route to capture-without-gate prompt instead; (2) failure-mode row for 'fw replay exit non-zero' narrowed to apply ONLY after the supported-seed gate passes, so unsupported seeds can't be mislabeled as determinism drift. fix-round-3 puts me at the 2-fix-round-max budget; if this round draws another counter I'll deadlock-escalate to user.

commit-proposal: round 3 addresses Codex P2 on 9644f2fc. SKILL.md Step 1 now (1) canonicalizes seed → strip 0x/0X + lowercase + 16-hex regex; (2) checks canonical seed against the explicit Phase-3 SUPPORTED_SEEDS=({0xdeadbeefdeadbeef}) client-side BEFORE any fw replay invocation; (3) routes unsupported canonicalized seeds to the 'capture without gate? [y/N]' prompt without ever invoking fw replay (so unsupported-seed rc=2 cannot mislabel as determinism break); (4) only after the supported-seed gate passes does fw replay run, at which point rc≠0 means a real determinism/tooling failure unambiguously. Failure-modes table row narrowed accordingly: 'fw replay exit non-zero AFTER passing the client-side supported-seed gate' = real break; unsupported-seed case has its own row that explicitly says 'Do NOT invoke fw replay here'. Verified at HEAD: scripts/fw replay deadbeefdeadbeef --compare-corpus AND scripts/fw replay 0x0000000000000000 --compare-corpus both rc=2; scripts/fw replay 0xdeadbeefdeadbeef --compare-corpus rc=0 with 2/2 MatchDeterminismTests passing. NO MatchSim/Unity/scripts source touched — skill doc only. fw verify Tier-A GREEN; MatchSim 644/644 UNCHANGED; pinned hash UNCHANGED. This is fix-round 3 (=2 of 2 budget). If another counter lands, I'll deadlock-escalate to user per ADR-0012 §C2. Awaiting ack.

ack — round-3 match-replay skill proposal approved. I rechecked SKILL.md and the two previous blockers are closed: seed handling now canonicalizes first, checks the explicit Phase-3 supported set before invoking scripts/fw replay, routes unsupported seeds to the capture-without-gate prompt without calling fw replay, and limits nonzero replay failures to the supported-seed path. The capture loop is state-driven via DotsMatchDirector.CurrentTick reflection and filenames use the actual captured tick rather than target labels. I verified local replay behavior: raw/unsupported seeds return rc=2, the smoke seed returns rc=0, git diff --check is clean, and scripts/fw verify is green with 644/644 MatchSim tests. No blocking findings.
